verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בִּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה בָּֽרְבִיעִי֙ בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ וַאֲנִ֥י בְתֽוֹךְ־ הַגּוֹלָ֖ה עַל־ נְהַר־ כְּבָ֑ר נִפְתְּחוּ֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וָאֶרְאֶ֖ה מַרְא֥וֹת אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî biš·lō·šîm šā·nāh bā·rə·ḇî·‘î ba·ḥă·miš·šāh la·ḥō·ḏeš wa·’ă·nî ḇə·ṯō·wḵ- hag·gō·w·lāh ‘al- nə·har- kə·ḇār nip̄·tə·ḥū haš·šā·ma·yim wā·’er·’eh mar·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: In the thirtieth year on the fifth day of the fourth month while I was among the exiles by the River Kebar the heavens opened and I saw visions of God
verses.literalPt: E ACONTECEU no trigésimo ano, no quarto mês, no quinto dia do mês, que estando eu no meio dos cativos, junto ao rio Quebar, se abriram os céus, e eu tive visões de Deus.

verses.original: בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הִ֚יא הַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַחֲמִישִׁ֔ית לְגָל֖וּת הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ יוֹיָכִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥă·miš·šāh la·ḥō·ḏeš hî haš·šā·nāh ha·ḥă·mî·šîṯ lə·ḡā·lūṯ ham·me·leḵ yō·w·yā·ḵîn
verses.literal: On the fifth day of the month it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin
verses.literalPt: No quinto dia do mês, no quinto ano do cativeiro do rei Jeoiaquim,

verses.original: הָיֹ֣ה הָיָ֣ה דְבַר־ יְ֠הוָה אֶל־ יְחֶזְקֵ֨אל בֶּן־ בּוּזִ֧י הַכֹּהֵ֛ן בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים עַל־ נְהַר־ כְּבָ֑ר וַתְּהִ֥י עָלָ֛יו שָׁ֖ם יַד־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·yōh hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yə·ḥez·qêl ben- bū·zî hak·kō·hên bə·’e·reṣ kaś·dîm ‘al- nə·har- kə·ḇār wat·tə·hî ‘ā·lāw šām yaḏ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: the word of the LORD came directly . . . to Ezekiel the priest the son of Buzi in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Kebar And there the LORD’s hand was upon him
verses.literalPt: Veio expressamente a palavra do SENHOR a Ezequiel, filho de Buzi, o sacerdote, na terra dos caldeus, junto ao rio Quebar, e ali esteve sobre ele a mão do SENHOR.

verses.original: וָאֵ֡רֶא וְהִנֵּה֩ ר֨וּחַ סְעָרָ֜ה בָּאָ֣ה מִן־ הַצָּפ֗וֹן עָנָ֤ן גָּדוֹל֙ וְאֵ֣שׁ מִתְלַקַּ֔חַת וְנֹ֥גַֽהּ ל֖וֹ סָבִ֑יב וּמִ֨תּוֹכָ֔הּ כְּעֵ֥ין הַחַשְׁמַ֖ל מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ê·re wə·hin·nêh rū·aḥ sə·‘ā·rāh bā·’āh min- haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ‘ā·nān gā·ḏō·wl wə·’êš miṯ·laq·qa·ḥaṯ wə·nō·ḡah lōw sā·ḇîḇ ū·mit·tō·w·ḵāh kə·‘ên ha·ḥaš·mal mit·tō·wḵ hā·’êš
verses.literal: I looked and saw a whirlwind . . . coming from the north a great cloud with fire flashing back and forth and brilliant light all around it In the center of the fire was a gleam like amber . . .
verses.literalPt: Olhei, e eis que um vento tempestuoso vinha do norte, uma grande nuvem, com um fogo revolvendo-se nela, e um resplendor ao redor, e no meio dela havia uma coisa, como de cor de âmbar, que saía do meio do fogo.

verses.original: וּמִ֨תּוֹכָ֔הּ דְּמ֖וּת אַרְבַּ֣ע חַיּ֑וֹת וְזֶה֙ מַרְאֵֽיהֶ֔ן דְּמ֥וּת אָדָ֖ם לָהֵֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mit·tō·w·ḵāh də·mūṯ ’ar·ba‘ ḥay·yō·wṯ wə·zeh mar·’ê·hen də·mūṯ ’ā·ḏām lā·hên·nāh
verses.literal: and within it was the form of four living creatures And this was their appearance They had a human form
verses.literalPt: E do meio dela saía a semelhança de quatro seres viventes. E esta era a sua aparência: tinham a semelhança de homem.

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה פָנִ֖ים לְאֶחָ֑ת וְאַרְבַּ֥ע כְּנָפַ֖יִם לְאַחַ֥ת לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ar·bā·‘āh p̄ā·nîm lə·’e·ḥāṯ wə·’ar·ba‘ kə·nā·p̄a·yim lə·’a·ḥaṯ lā·hem
verses.literal: but each had four faces and four wings . . .
verses.literalPt: E cada um tinha quatro rostos, como também cada um deles quatro asas.

verses.original: וְרַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם רֶ֣גֶל יְשָׁרָ֑ה וְכַ֣ף רַגְלֵיהֶ֗ם כְּכַף֙ רֶ֣גֶל עֵ֔גֶל וְנֹ֣צְצִ֔ים כְּעֵ֖ין נְחֹ֥שֶׁת קָלָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·raḡ·lê·hem re·ḡel yə·šā·rāh wə·ḵap̄ raḡ·lê·hem kə·ḵap̄ re·ḡel ‘ê·ḡel wə·nō·ṣə·ṣîm kə·‘ên nə·ḥō·šeṯ qā·lāl
verses.literal: Their legs were straight and the soles of their feet were like the hooves . . . . . . of a calf gleaming like polished bronze
verses.literalPt: E os seus pés eram pés direitos; e as plantas dos seus pés como a planta do pé de uma bezerra, e luziam como a cor de cobre polido.

verses.original: וְיָדוֹ אָדָ֗ם מִתַּ֙חַת֙ כַּנְפֵיהֶ֔ם עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣עַת רִבְעֵיהֶ֑ם וּפְנֵיהֶ֥ם וְכַנְפֵיהֶ֖ם לְאַרְבַּעְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yå̄·ḏō ’ā·ḏām mit·ta·ḥaṯ kan·p̄ê·hem ‘al ’ar·ba·‘aṯ riḇ·‘ê·hem ū·p̄ə·nê·hem wə·ḵan·p̄ê·hem lə·’ar·ba‘·tām
verses.literal: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands All four living creatures had faces and wings
verses.literalPt: E tinham mãos de homem debaixo das suas asas, aos quatro lados; e assim todos quatro tinham seus rostos e suas asas.

verses.original: חֹֽבְרֹ֛ת אִשָּׁ֥ה אֶל־ אֲחוֹתָ֖הּ כַּנְפֵיהֶ֑ם לֹא־ יִסַּ֣בּוּ בְלֶכְתָּ֔ן אִ֛ישׁ אֶל־ עֵ֥בֶר פָּנָ֖יו יֵלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥō·ḇə·rōṯ ’iš·šāh ’el- ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯāh kan·p̄ê·hem lō- yis·sab·bū ḇə·leḵ·tān ’îš ’el- ‘ê·ḇer pā·nāw yê·lê·ḵū
verses.literal: and their wings were touching one another . . . They did not turn as they moved each . . . one went straight ahead
verses.literalPt: Uniam-se as suas asas uma à outra; não se viravam quando andavam, e cada qual andava continuamente em frente.

verses.original: וּדְמ֣וּת פְּנֵיהֶם֮ פְּנֵ֣י אָדָם֒ וּפְנֵ֨י אַרְיֵ֤ה אֶל־ הַיָּמִין֙ לְאַרְבַּעְתָּ֔ם וּפְנֵי־ שׁ֥וֹר מֵֽהַשְּׂמֹ֖אול לְאַרְבַּעְתָּ֑ן וּפְנֵי־ נֶ֖שֶׁר לְאַרְבַּעְתָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḏə·mūṯ pə·nê·hem pə·nê ’ā·ḏām ū·p̄ə·nê ’ar·yêh ’el- hay·yā·mîn lə·’ar·ba‘·tām ū·p̄ə·nê- šō·wr mê·haś·śə·mō·wl lə·’ar·ba‘·tān ū·p̄ə·nê- ne·šer lə·’ar·ba‘·tān
verses.literal: The form of their faces was that of a man and each of the four had the face of a lion on the right side the face of an ox on the left side and also the face of an eagle . . .
verses.literalPt: E a semelhança dos seus rostos era como o rosto de homem; e do lado direito todos os quatro tinham rosto de leão, e do lado esquerdo todos os quatro tinham rosto de boi; e também tinham rosto de águia todos os quatro.

verses.original: וּפְנֵיהֶ֕ם וְכַנְפֵיהֶ֥ם פְּרֻד֖וֹת מִלְמָ֑עְלָה לְאִ֗ישׁ שְׁ֚תַּיִם חֹבְר֣וֹת אִ֔ישׁ וּשְׁתַּ֣יִם מְכַסּ֔וֹת אֵ֖ת גְּוִיֹתֵיהֶֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·nê·hem wə·ḵan·p̄ê·hem pə·ru·ḏō·wṯ mil·mā·‘ə·lāh lə·’îš šə·ta·yim ḥō·ḇə·rō·wṯ ’îš ū·šə·ta·yim mə·ḵas·sō·wṯ ’êṯ gə·wi·yō·ṯē·hɛ·nå̄h
verses.literal: Such were their faces Their wings were spread upward each had two wings touching the wings of the creature on either side and two wings covering its body
verses.literalPt: Assim eram os seus rostos. As suas asas estavam estendidas por cima; cada qual tinha duas asas juntas uma a outra, e duas cobriam os corpos deles.

verses.original: וְאִ֛ישׁ אֶל־ עֵ֥בֶר פָּנָ֖יו יֵלֵ֑כוּ אֶ֣ל אֲשֶׁר֩ יִֽהְיֶה־ שָׁ֨מָּה הָר֤וּחַ לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ יֵלֵ֔כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּלֶכְתָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’el- ‘ê·ḇer pā·nāw yê·lê·ḵū ’el ’ă·šer yih·yeh- šām·māh hā·rū·aḥ lā·le·ḵeṯ yê·lê·ḵū lō yis·sab·bū bə·leḵ·tān
verses.literal: Each creature went straight ahead . . . . . . Wherever - . . . the spirit would go they would go without turning as they moved
verses.literalPt: E cada qual andava para adiante de si; para onde o espírito havia de ir, iam; não se viravam quando andavam.

verses.original: וּדְמ֨וּת הַחַיּ֜וֹת מַרְאֵיהֶ֣ם כְּגַחֲלֵי־ אֵ֗שׁ בֹּֽעֲרוֹת֙ כְּמַרְאֵ֣ה הַלַּפִּדִ֔ים הִ֕יא מִתְהַלֶּ֖כֶת בֵּ֣ין הַחַיּ֑וֹת וְנֹ֣גַהּ לָאֵ֔שׁ וּמִן־ הָאֵ֖שׁ יוֹצֵ֥א בָרָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḏə·mūṯ ha·ḥay·yō·wṯ mar·’ê·hem kə·ḡa·ḥă·lê- ’êš bō·‘ă·rō·wṯ kə·mar·’êh hal·lap·pi·ḏîm hî miṯ·hal·le·ḵeṯ bên ha·ḥay·yō·wṯ wə·nō·ḡah lā·’êš ū·min- hā·’êš yō·w·ṣê ḇā·rāq
verses.literal: In the midst of the living creatures was the appearance of glowing coals of fire or of torches . . . Fire moved back and forth between the living creatures it was bright and lightning flashed out of it
verses.literalPt: E, quanto à semelhança dos seres viventes, o seu aspecto era como ardentes brasas de fogo, com uma aparência de lâmpadas; o fogo subia e descia por entre os seres viventes, e o fogo resplandecia, e do fogo saíam relâmpagos;

verses.original: וְהַחַיּ֖וֹת רָצ֣וֹא וָשׁ֑וֹב כְּמַרְאֵ֖ה הַבָּזָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·ḥay·yō·wṯ rā·ṣō·w wā·šō·wḇ kə·mar·’êh hab·bā·zāq
verses.literal: The creatures were darting back and forth . . . as quickly as flashes of lightning
verses.literalPt: E os seres viventes corriam, e voltavam, à semelhança de um clarão de relâmpago.

verses.original: וָאֵ֖רֶא הַחַיּ֑וֹת וְהִנֵּה֩ אוֹפַ֨ן אֶחָ֥ד בָּאָ֛רֶץ אֵ֥צֶל הַחַיּ֖וֹת לְאַרְבַּ֥עַת פָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ê·re ha·ḥay·yō·wṯ wə·hin·nêh ’ō·w·p̄an ’e·ḥāḏ bā·’ā·reṣ ’ê·ṣel ha·ḥay·yō·wṯ lə·’ar·ba·‘aṯ pā·nāw
verses.literal: When I looked at the living creatures I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces
verses.literalPt: E vi os seres viventes; e eis que havia uma roda sobre a terra junto aos seres viventes, uma para cada um dos quatro rostos.

verses.original: מַרְאֵ֨ה הָאוֹפַנִּ֤ים וּמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם֙ כְּעֵ֣ין תַּרְשִׁ֔ישׁ וּדְמ֥וּת אֶחָ֖ד לְאַרְבַּעְתָּ֑ן וּמַרְאֵיהֶם֙ וּמַ֣עֲשֵׂיהֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יִהְיֶ֥ה הָאוֹפַ֖ן בְּת֥וֹךְ הָאוֹפָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: mar·’êh hā·’ō·w·p̄an·nîm ū·ma·‘ă·śê·hem kə·‘ên tar·šîš ū·ḏə·mūṯ ’e·ḥāḏ lə·’ar·ba‘·tān ū·mar·’ê·hem ū·ma·‘ă·śê·hem ka·’ă·šer yih·yeh hā·’ō·w·p̄an bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·’ō·w·p̄ān
verses.literal: The workmanship of the wheels looked like the gleam of beryl and all four had the same likeness Their workmanship looked like . . . a wheel within a wheel
verses.literalPt: O aspecto das rodas, e a obra delas, era como a cor de berilo; e as quatro tinham uma mesma semelhança; e o seu aspecto, e a sua obra, era como se estivera uma roda no meio de outra roda.

verses.original: עַל־ אַרְבַּ֥עַת רִבְעֵיהֶ֖ן בְּלֶכְתָּ֣ם יֵלֵ֑כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּלֶכְתָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- ’ar·ba·‘aṯ riḇ·‘ê·hen bə·leḵ·tām yê·lê·ḵū lō yis·sab·bū bə·leḵ·tān
verses.literal: As they moved they went in any of the four directions without pivoting as they moved
verses.literalPt: Andando elas, andavam pelos seus quatro lados; não se viravam quando andavam.

verses.original: וְגַ֨בֵּיהֶ֔ן וְגֹ֥בַהּ לָהֶ֖ם וְיִרְאָ֣ה לָהֶ֑ם וְגַבֹּתָ֗ם מְלֵאֹ֥ת עֵינַ֛יִם סָבִ֖יב לְאַרְבַּעְתָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡab·bê·hen wə·ḡō·ḇah lā·hem wə·yir·’āh lā·hem wə·ḡab·bō·ṯām mə·lê·’ōṯ ‘ê·na·yim sā·ḇîḇ lə·’ar·ba‘·tān
verses.literal: Their rims were high and awesome . . . and all four rims were full of eyes all around
verses.literalPt: E os seus aros eram tão altos, que faziam medo; e estas quatro tinham as suas cambotas cheias de olhos ao redor.

verses.original: וּבְלֶ֙כֶת֙ הַֽחַיּ֔וֹת יֵלְכ֥וּ הָאוֹפַנִּ֖ים אֶצְלָ֑ם וּבְהִנָּשֵׂ֤א הַֽחַיּוֹת֙ מֵעַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ יִנָּשְׂא֖וּ הָאוֹפַנִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·le·ḵeṯ ha·ḥay·yō·wṯ yê·lə·ḵū hā·’ō·w·p̄an·nîm ’eṣ·lām ū·ḇə·hin·nā·śê ha·ḥay·yō·wṯ mê·‘al hā·’ā·reṣ yin·nā·śə·’ū hā·’ō·w·p̄an·nîm
verses.literal: So as the living creatures moved the wheels moved beside them and when the creatures rose from the ground the wheels also rose
verses.literalPt: E, andando os seres viventes, andavam as rodas ao lado deles; e, elevando-se os seres viventes da terra, elevavam-se também as rodas.

verses.original: עַ֣ל אֲשֶׁר֩ יִֽהְיֶה־ שָּׁ֨ם הָר֤וּחַ לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ יֵלֵ֔כוּ שָׁ֥מָּה הָר֖וּחַ לָלֶ֑כֶת וְהָאוֹפַנִּ֗ים יִנָּשְׂאוּ֙ לְעֻמָּתָ֔ם כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ הַחַיָּ֖ה בָּאוֹפַנִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al ’ă·šer yih·yeh- šām hā·rū·aḥ lā·le·ḵeṯ yê·lê·ḵū šām·māh hā·rū·aḥ lā·le·ḵeṯ wə·hā·’ō·w·p̄an·nîm yin·nā·śə·’ū lə·‘um·mā·ṯām kî rū·aḥ ha·ḥay·yāh bā·’ō·w·p̄an·nîm
verses.literal: Wherever - . . . the spirit would go they would go . . . . . . . . . and the wheels would rise alongside them because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels
verses.literalPt: Para onde o espírito queria ir, eles iam; para onde o espírito tinha de ir; e as rodas se elevavam defronte deles, porque o espírito do ser vivente estava nas rodas.

verses.original: בְּלֶכְתָּ֣ם יֵלֵ֔כוּ וּבְעָמְדָ֖ם יַֽעֲמֹ֑דוּ וּֽבְהִנָּשְׂאָ֞ם מֵעַ֣ל הָאָ֗רֶץ יִנָּשְׂא֤וּ הָאֽוֹפַנִּים֙ לְעֻמָּתָ֔ם כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ הַחַיָּ֖ה בָּאוֹפַנִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·leḵ·tām yê·lê·ḵū ū·ḇə·‘ā·mə·ḏām ya·‘ă·mō·ḏū ū·ḇə·hin·nā·śə·’ām mê·‘al hā·’ā·reṣ yin·nā·śə·’ū hā·’ō·w·p̄an·nîm lə·‘um·mā·ṯām kî rū·aḥ ha·ḥay·yāh bā·’ō·w·p̄an·nîm
verses.literal: When the creatures moved the wheels moved when the creatures stood still the wheels stood still and when the creatures rose from the ground the wheels rose alongside them because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels
verses.literalPt: Andando eles, andavam elas e, parando eles, paravam elas e, elevando-se eles da terra, elevavam-se também as rodas defronte deles; porque o espírito do ser vivente estava nas rodas.

verses.original: וּדְמ֞וּת עַל־ רָאשֵׁ֤י הַחַיָּה֙ רָקִ֔יעַ כְּעֵ֖ין הַקֶּ֣רַח הַנּוֹרָ֑א נָט֥וּי עַל־ רָאשֵׁיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḏə·mūṯ ‘al- rā·šê ha·ḥay·yāh rā·qî·a‘ kə·‘ên haq·qe·raḥ han·nō·w·rā nā·ṭui ‘al- rā·šê·hem mil·mā·‘ə·lāh
verses.literal: Spread out above . . . the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an awesome expanse gleaming like crystal
verses.literalPt: E sobre as cabeças dos seres viventes havia uma semelhança de firmamento, com a aparência de cristal terrível, estendido por cima, sobre as suas cabeças.

verses.original: וְתַ֙חַת֙ הָרָקִ֔יעַ כַּנְפֵיהֶ֣ם יְשָׁר֔וֹת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־ אֲחוֹתָ֑הּ לְאִ֗ישׁ שְׁתַּ֤יִם מְכַסּוֹת֙ לָהֵ֔נָּה וּלְאִ֗ישׁ שְׁתַּ֤יִם מְכַסּוֹת֙ לָהֵ֔נָּה אֵ֖ת גְּוִיֹּתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ hā·rā·qî·a‘ kan·p̄ê·hem yə·šā·rō·wṯ ’iš·šāh ’el- ’ă·ḥō·w·ṯāh lə·’îš šə·ta·yim mə·ḵas·sō·wṯ lā·hên·nāh ū·lə·’îš šə·ta·yim mə·ḵas·sō·wṯ lā·hên·nāh ’êṯ gə·wî·yō·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: And under the expanse their wings stretched out toward one another Each one also had two wings covering its body
verses.literalPt: E debaixo do firmamento estavam as suas asas direitas uma em direção à outra; cada um tinha duas, que lhe cobriam o corpo de um lado; e cada um tinha outras duas asas, que os cobriam do outro lado.

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁמַ֣ע אֶת־ ק֣וֹל כַּנְפֵיהֶ֡ם כְּקוֹל֩ מַ֨יִם רַבִּ֤ים כְּקוֹל־ שַׁדַּי֙ בְּלֶכְתָּ֔ם ק֥וֹל הֲמֻלָּ֖ה כְּק֣וֹל מַחֲנֶ֑ה בְּעָמְדָ֖ם תְּרַפֶּ֥ינָה כַנְפֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·ma‘ ’eṯ- qō·wl kan·p̄ê·hem kə·qō·wl ma·yim rab·bîm kə·qō·wl- šad·day bə·leḵ·tām qō·wl hă·mul·lāh kə·qō·wl ma·ḥă·neh bə·‘ā·mə·ḏām tə·rap·pe·nāh ḵan·p̄ê·hen
verses.literal: When the creatures moved I heard the sound of their wings like the roar of many waters like the voice of the Almighty like the tumult . . . of an army When they stood still they lowered their wings
verses.literalPt: E, andando eles, ouvi o ruído das suas asas, como o ruído de muitas águas, como a voz do Onipotente, um tumulto como o estrépito de um exército; parando eles, abaixavam as suas asas.

verses.original: וַיְהִי־ ק֕וֹל מֵעַ֕ל לָרָקִ֖יעַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ רֹאשָׁ֑ם בְּעָמְדָ֖ם תְּרַפֶּ֥ינָה כַנְפֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî- qō·wl mê·‘al lā·rā·qî·a‘ ’ă·šer ‘al- rō·šām bə·‘ā·mə·ḏām tə·rap·pe·nāh ḵan·p̄ê·hen
verses.literal: And there came a voice from above the expanse over their heads as they stood still with their wings lowered
verses.literalPt: E ouviu-se uma voz vinda do firmamento, que estava por cima das suas cabeças; parando eles, abaixavam as suas asas.

verses.original: וּמִמַּ֗עַל לָרָקִ֙יעַ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ רֹאשָׁ֔ם כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה אֶֽבֶן־ סַפִּ֖יר דְּמ֣וּת כִּסֵּ֑א וְעַל֙ דְּמ֣וּת הַכִּסֵּ֔א דְּמ֞וּת כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה אָדָ֛ם עָלָ֖יו מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mim·ma·‘al lā·rā·qî·a‘ ’ă·šer ‘al- rō·šām kə·mar·’êh ’e·ḇen- sap·pîr də·mūṯ kis·sê wə·‘al də·mūṯ hak·kis·sê də·mūṯ kə·mar·’êh ’ā·ḏām ‘ā·lāw mil·mā·‘ə·lāh
verses.literal: Above the expanse over their heads was the likeness of a throne . . . with the appearance of sapphire . . . and on the throne high above was a figure like that of a man . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E por cima do firmamento, que estava por cima das suas cabeças, havia algo semelhante a um trono que parecia de pedra de safira; e sobre esta espécie de trono havia uma figura semelhante à de um homem, na parte de cima, sobre ele.

verses.original: וָאֵ֣רֶא׀ כְּעֵ֣ין חַשְׁמַ֗ל כְּמַרְאֵה־ אֵ֤שׁ בֵּֽית־ לָהּ֙ סָבִ֔יב מִמַּרְאֵ֥ה מָתְנָ֖יו וּלְמָ֑עְלָה וּמִמַּרְאֵ֤ה מָתְנָיו֙ וּלְמַ֔טָּה רָאִ֙יתִי֙ כְּמַרְאֵה־ אֵ֔שׁ וְנֹ֥גַֽהּ ל֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ê·re kə·‘ên ḥaš·mal kə·mar·’êh- ’êš bêṯ- lāh sā·ḇîḇ mim·mar·’êh mā·ṯə·nāw ū·lə·mā·‘ə·lāh ū·mim·mar·’êh mā·ṯə·nāw ū·lə·maṭ·ṭāh rā·’î·ṯî kə·mar·’êh- ’êš wə·nō·ḡah lōw sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: From what seemed to be His waist up I saw a gleam like amber with what looked like fire within it all around And from what seemed to be His waist down I saw what looked like fire and brilliant light surrounded Him
verses.literalPt: E vi-a como a cor de âmbar, como a aparência do fogo pelo interior dele ao redor, desde o aspecto dos seus lombos, e daí para cima; e, desde o aspecto dos seus lombos e daí para baixo, vi como a semelhança de fogo, e um resplendor ao redor dele.

verses.original: כְּמַרְאֵ֣ה הַקֶּ֡שֶׁת אֲשֶׁר֩ יִֽהְיֶ֨ה בֶעָנָ֜ן בְּי֣וֹם הַגֶּ֗שֶׁם כֵּ֣ן מַרְאֵ֤ה הַנֹּ֙גַהּ֙ סָבִ֔יב ה֕וּא מַרְאֵ֖ה דְּמ֣וּת כְּבוֹד־ יְהוָ֑ה וָֽאֶרְאֶה֙ וָאֶפֹּ֣ל עַל־ פָּנַ֔י וָאֶשְׁמַ֖ע ק֥וֹל מְדַבֵּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: kə·mar·’êh haq·qe·šeṯ ’ă·šer yih·yeh ḇe·‘ā·nān bə·yō·wm hag·ge·šem kên mar·’êh han·nō·ḡah sā·ḇîḇ hū mar·’êh də·mūṯ kə·ḇō·wḏ- Yah·weh wā·’er·’eh wā·’ep·pōl ‘al- pā·nay wā·’eš·ma‘ qō·wl mə·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: The appearance of the brilliant light all around Him was like that of a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD And when I saw it I fell facedown . . . and heard a voice speaking
verses.literalPt: Como o aspecto do arco que aparece na nuvem no dia da chuva, assim era o aspecto do resplendor em redor. Este era o aspecto da semelhança da glória do SENHOR; e, vendo isto, caí sobre o meu rosto, e ouvi a voz de quem falava.
